checks.item: Kinshasa Financial Center, Ministry of Finance tower: completed 2023, height 107 m, at -4.3092, 15.2803 (documented)
checks.source_opened: https://zoom-eco.net/a-la-une/rdc-felix-tshisekedi-inspecte-les-travaux-de-construction-du-centre-financier-de-kinshasa/ (via WebFetch; direct curl got a bot-check page) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kinshasa_Financial_Center&action=raw ; https://afrique.le360.ma/societe/kinshasa-par-lelegance-de-son-architecture-le-centre-financier-embellit-la-ville-et-diversifie-son_ZN6RIMUJIJGKPGJHHOF4CLEJUQ/ ; https://infos.cd/economie/infrastructures-les-travaux-du-nouveau-centre-financier-de-kinshasa-deja-realises-a-plus-de-70/31031
checks.found: Zoom Eco, 9 November 2022 (work 30% complete): 'Une tour du ministère des Finances de 20 étages sur une hauteur de 107 mètres'. Wikipedia: completed and inaugurated 19 December 2023, coordinates 4°18'34"S 15°16'49"E (-4.3094, 15.2803). Later reports differ on the towers: infos.cd, 15 September 2023, 'longues de 20 et 18 niveaux'; Le360, 26 December 2023, 'quatre tours de 21 niveaux chacune'. No as-built height found.
checks.detail: The cited article does state 107 m, but as a design figure a year before completion, and later reports give different floor counts. Kept the value, lowered confidence from documented to estimated and extended the note to say why and where the 2023 completion date comes from.

checks.item: 1923: Named capital of the Belgian Congo. A royal decree of 1 July 1923 moved the colonial capital from Boma to Léopoldville; Kalina (now Gombe) built between Léopoldville-West and Kinshasa.
checks.found: 'By 1923, the city was elevated to capital of the Belgian Congo, replacing the town of Boma ... pursuant to the Royal Decree of 1 July 1923'; a new administrative district 'between Kinshasa ... and Léopoldville-West. The site, named Kalina (now Gombe), became the colonial administrative center', cited to Piette (2011). The same passage says the services finished moving to Kalina in the first half of 1930.
checks.detail: Decree date and description match the cited page.

summary: The start year, the four colonial population counts, the RTNC tower and both milestones matched their sources. The two sampled Kinshasa Financial Center buildings (and, as an extra check, the third) carry design-stage heights from a November 2022 press report, with later reports describing the towers differently; their values were kept but confidence was lowered from documented to estimated with an explanatory note.
